Commentary: Namibia Squad: Michael van Lingen, Louren Steenkamp, Jan Frylinck, Gerhard Erasmus(c), Zane Green(w), Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton, JJ Smit, Ruben Trumpelmann, Waldo Smith, Bernard Scholtz, Jack Brassell, Alexander Volschenk, Jan Balt, Max Heingo, Junior Taanyanda, Malan Kruger

Ireland Squad: Andrew Balbirnie, Paul Stirling(c), Cade Carmichael, Harry Tector, Lorcan Tucker(w), Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Andy McBrine, Gavin Hoey, Liam McCarthy, Jai Moondra, Byron McDonough, Jordan Neill, Matthew Humphreys, Benjamin Calitz, Mark Adair
Squads:
Andy McBrine to Loftie-Eaton, 1 run, flat good length on off and middle, Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton gets forward to punch to sweeper cover
Andy McBrine to Gerhard Erasmus, 1 run, good length outside off, turns in a bit, Gerhard Erasmus goes on the back foot to tap it to the short mid-wicket area for one
Curtis Campher to Gerhard Erasmus, 2 runs, length delivery and Gerhard Erasmus comes down the track to loft, gets lucky as the thick outside-edge clears backward point running back
Curtis Campher to Gerhard Erasmus, FOUR, superb pull this. It's short of length on off, he stays on the front foot and muscles the pull over mid-wicket. Really belted the ball
Curtis Campher to Gerhard Erasmus, 1 run, short of length on off, Gerhard Erasmus opens the face of the bat and glides it down to third man
Curtis Campher to Loftie-Eaton, no run, back of a length outside off, Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton goes on the back foot and punches to backward point
Curtis Campher to Loftie-Eaton, no run, slower-ball and full outside off, Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton gets forward to heave and misses. Doesn't carry to Lorcan Tucker

Curtis Campher to Loftie-Eaton, no run, three dots in a row. It's a pacy short delivery outside off, Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton goes on the back foot to pull, it gets big on him. He mistimes it to mid-wicket
Gavin Hoey to Gerhard Erasmus, leg byes, 1 run, Gerhard Erasmus comes down the track and fails to nudge this to the leg-side. Impact is outside off and he takes a legbye
Gavin Hoey to Loftie-Eaton, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Gavin Hoey to Loftie-Eaton, out Caught by Paul Stirling!! The top-edge is found and Stirling goes back at short fine to take it on the reverse-cup. It's full on middle, Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton sinks low to sweep, the top-edge is found and Stirling takes a good catch. Loftie-Eaton c Paul Stirling b Gavin Hoey 15(22) [4s-1]
Zane Green, left handed bat, comes to the crease
Gavin Hoey to Zane Green, no run, short outside off, turning away, Zane Green goes on the back foot and mistimes the pull to the left of mid-wicket who gets across and cuts it off
Gavin Hoey to Zane Green, 1 run, good length on middle, Zane Green goes on the back foot and turns it wide of mid-wicket

Gavin Hoey to Gerhard Erasmus, 2 runs, great running this. It's tossed up full and Gerhard Erasmus comes down the track to flick in front of deep square-leg. The call was for two and they run hard to come back for two

Gavin Hoey to Gerhard Erasmus, leg byes, 1 run, tossed up full outside off, Gerhard Erasmus comes down the track and is well outside the line when he tries to flick, misses, off the pad to short third man for a legbye
Byron McDonough [6.0-0-38-1] is back into the attack
Byron McDonough to Gerhard Erasmus, no run, short of length and cramps Gerhard Erasmus as he comes down the track to cut, mistimes it in front of backward point

Byron McDonough to Gerhard Erasmus, FOUR, was it off-pace? Looked like it was. Sat up short outside off, Gerhard Erasmus is on the front foot as he nails the pull wide of mid-wicket who dives but the ball speeds past
Byron McDonough to Gerhard Erasmus, 3 runs, to deep backward point
